name: 人物角色参考板
description: 从一张人物参考图建立可复用的人物设计图，覆盖正面、侧面、背面全身视图、脸部结构、体型比例、发型发色、表情、服装配件、肤质和年龄感，用于后续人物生成与身份一致性控制。
prompt_template: Create a highly detailed professional character development reference sheet for {character_subject}. Use the uploaded reference image as the ONLY source for identity. {identity_lock} Layout: clean separated production panels with thin dividers and minimal section labels. Include neutral full-body front, true 90-degree side profile, back, and optional three-quarter views; head-and-shoulders front, three-quarter left/right, true left/right profiles, slight high and low angles, and rear hair view; close-ups for face structure, skin texture, eyes, eyebrows, lips, distinctive marks, hands, fingers, shoes, clothing construction, fabric, seams, folds, buttons, jewelry and accessories. Keep every panel the exact same person with identical facial geometry, natural asymmetry, eyes, brows, nose, lips, jaw, cheeks, ears, hairline, hairstyle, hair color, skin tone, apparent age, height/build, head-to-body ratio, outfit and accessories. {sheet_layout} Photorealistic studio photography, natural 50–85mm portrait perspective, controlled neutral lighting, realistic pores and hair strands, accurate anatomy, no beautification, no idealization, no stylization, no beauty filter, no extra people, no invented details, no text artifacts, no watermark.
negative_prompt_template: {negative_prompt}, different person between panels, inconsistent face, changing hairstyle, changing outfit, altered body proportions, missing side view, missing back view, cropped feet, extra limbs, duplicated person, unreadable labels, fantasy collage, dramatic perspective, distorted anatomy, plastic skin, watermark

defaults.character_subject: the adult person shown in the reference image
defaults.identity_lock: preserve exact recognizable identity; do not beautify, redesign, replace, gender-swap, age-shift, or turn the subject into a lookalike
defaults.sheet_layout: balanced editorial contact-sheet layout with neutral white or gray studio background and consistent scale across panels
